title: A filter in the middle of a chain goes down to the fact table but not up to the one side
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Categories", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Category ), Product[Product] = "R1" ), "Quantity", CALCULATE ( SUM ( Sales[Quantity] ), Product[Product] = "R1" ) )

source.quote: In a one-to-many relationship, the direction is always from the one-side of the relationship to the many-side
source.supports: single direction: one side to many side only

source.quote: For one-to-many relationships, the cross filter direction is always from the "one" side, and optionally from the "many" side (bi-directional)
source.supports: filters propagate from the one side

derivation: Product R1 (100) filters Sales to rows 1 and 2: Quantity 1 + 2 = 3. Product is on the many side of Product -> Subcategory, and Subcategory on the many side of Subcategory -> Category, both single direction, so Category keeps its 3 rows.
